excludedSurfaces.reason: This slice is persistent preview only and cannot publish to production.
Navigation requires separate IA, content, and admin review.
Footer identity and role claims depend on unresolved business/legal decisions.
Structured specs remain blocked by unresolved product data and B-022 conflicts.
Compatibility requires structured source data and approved relationships.
Checkout is Shopify-controlled and out of scope for this theme preview slice.
The slice proves an introduction only, not a complete homepage redesign.
The slice uses existing templates and narrowly scoped adapters.
No new data model is approved for this slice.
Product titles and handles are not edited in this slice.
Policy copy remains legal and operations gated.
Shopify notifications are not touched by this preview proof.
No app or app embed is required to prove the first brand slice.
Video requires separate ownership, privacy, caption, transcript, and performance review.
Diagrams require approved source-controlled technical evidence.
Launch texture remains CSS-only and restrained.
Product media migration requires media-rights and alt-text review.
Content migration remains governed by B-024 and is out of scope.
